newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela says its ambassador among Peru hostages.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela says its ambassador among Peru hostages.

text.p: Venezuela's ambassador to Peru is among an estimated 200 hostages being held in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, a top Venezuelan government official said on Wednesday.

Deputy Foreign Minister Milos Alcalay told Reuters ambassador Horacio Arteaga was unhurt when his wife Caroline last saw him at the residency before she was released together with about 80 women and old people.
"We're monitoring the situation closely ... and studying what steps can be taken ... to solve this serious problem," he said.
